title: Controllers back after a swap: does the Arisen answer the controller?
intro: Game window in front, no co-op, not playing a pawn. Both controllers on. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Controller A only: move the left stick and press a few buttons. Does the Arisen move?
Controller B only: the same. Does the Arisen move?
Keyboard: W and Space. Then done; tell Claude what moved him.

probes.pads:
local o = {}
pcall(function() o[#o + 1] = "mode=" .. tostring(sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.UserInputManager"):call("get_HIDInputMode")) end)
pcall(function()
  local inp = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):call("get_ManualPlayer"):call("get_Input")
  o[#o + 1] = string.format("arisen=%X mag=%.2f", inp:get_field("ButtonOnFlags") or 0, inp:call("get_AxisMagnitudeL") or 0)
end)
pcall(function()
  local gp = sdk.get_native_singleton("via.hid.GamePad"); local td = sdk.find_type_definition("via.hid.GamePad")
  local arr = sdk.call_native_func(gp, td, "get_ConnectingDevices")
  for i = 0, arr:call("get_Count") - 1 do local dv = arr:call("get_Item", i); o[#o + 1] = string.format("d%d=%X", i, dv:call("get_Button") or 0) end
end)
local R = _G.DPC_dbg and _G.DPC_dbg.R
if R then o[#o + 1] = "fixes=" .. tostring(R.tp.pm_fixes or 0) .. " coop=" .. tostring(R.api_table.state().coop.active) end
return table.concat(o, " ")
